records.readable_german: Fuer ZITAG, ohne Nummer: nichts weiter kaufen und nichts weiter verladen, alles moeglichst sichern. ZITAG. Veranlasstes an K. M. drahten. Q. M. ALLQ. KR. DEP. No. 2439 Strich 18, G. ANCH.
records.title: A complete ZITAG stop order with reporting instruction and literal footer
records.meaning: The message instructs ZITAG to stop further purchases and loading, secure everything as far as possible, and telegraph the action taken to K.M. Its longer closing includes the literal office-like field Q M ALLQ KR DEP and reference 2439 STRICH 18 G ANCH. Those fields are preserved without silently normalizing Q to K or ALLQ to ALLG.
records.reading_note: All 320 received coordinates and 160 plaintext positions decode directly. The procurement-stop body was already read from shorter p102/p103 witnesses; this newly reviewed physical record supplies a complete longer native text, including the reporting instruction. The certificate compares the nonseparator body labels with the earlier composite candidate while preserving different X separators and different transposition lengths.

records.readable_german: Vertretung dort kath. Div. Pfarrers nicht moeglich. OKM. RM2C Nr. 38029.
records.title: No substitute for the Catholic divisional chaplain
records.meaning: The proposed wording says that providing a substitute or cover for the Catholic divisional chaplain there is not possible. It retains the literal OKM and RM2C designation and reference 38029; it does not name a chaplain or explain the reason.
records.reading_note: Two observed-coordinate substitutions propose PFARRERS for PFARRPRS and MOEGLICH for MOEGLICK. All 62 raw positions are already fixed, and no source mask or frame change is used. RM2C and 38029 are preserved.

records.readable_german: Funka OSM. Mit Entsendg. 10TK Senders nach Bukarest, wenn Transp. moegl., einverst. Nachchef 4B.
records.title: Conditional consent to send a transmitter to Bucharest
records.meaning: The sender agrees to dispatch the device written 10TK SENDER to Bucharest if transport is possible. OSM and Nachchef 4B remain literal routing and signature labels. No conversion of 10TK into a power rating is made, and this consent does not establish that the transmitter was shipped.
records.reading_note: All 156 source coordinates and 78 plaintext positions are direct. Enlarged source groups are GGGDD and AVGGF, both with clear G glyphs; low-resolution C readings are resolved visual uncertainties, not printed erasures or historical edits. The technical label 10TK is kept exactly.

records.readable_german: Wir rufen Sie jede Ringbahnperiode 0345 nach Ihrem Verkehr, Welle 1200.
records.title: Ringbahn call arrangement: 0345 after the other station's traffic
records.meaning: The sender announces calls in each Ringbahn period, with the time label 0345 after the recipient's traffic and wavelength 1200. The single word proposal changes RIN7BAHN to RINGBAHN through a counted source-coordinate substitution. It leaves 0345 and 1200 unchanged.
records.reading_note: The source has exactly the advertised 130 coordinates. One coordinate substitution repairs the ordinary Ringbahn word; the published square and every other label remain unchanged. No unit is added to WELLE 1200.
